stories.h: Christmas airfares double as return tickets hit ₦822,000
stories.p: Domestic airfares have reportedly risen by as much as 100% in three weeks, with some return tickets now above ₦800,000 ahead of Christmas. Travellers heading to the South-East and South-South are hit hardest.
body: Nigerians planning to fly home for Christmas are facing steep price rises, with domestic airfares reportedly up by as much as 100% in just three weeks.
## The prices

Return tickets on some routes now cost more than ₦800,000, with fares as high as ₦822,000 recorded on some airline booking platforms. Airlines including Air Peace and United Nigeria are among those whose prices have gone up.
Airlines including Air Peace and United Nigeria are among those that have raised fares.
The increases are raising the cost of travel for millions of Nigerians, especially those heading to the South-East and South-South for the festive season.
## Why prices are rising

Airlines are said to be struggling to meet the seasonal surge in demand with limited aircraft, while also dealing with higher operating costs. Security worries on major highways are also pushing more travellers towards flying.
Several carriers are reportedly adding extra flights on domestic and international routes between late November and mid-December to cope with the expected rush, but fares have continued to climb.
more: Fares are up by as much as 100% in three weeks.
Some return tickets cost ₦822,000.
Airlines are adding extra flights for the festive rush.

stories.h: Davido buys $2.1m Brabus Mercedes G-Wagon as birthday gift to himself
stories.p: Davido has reportedly bought a Brabus XLP 800 Adventure Mercedes G 66, said to be worth $2.1 million, to mark his 34th birthday. A video of him driving it surfaced on Tuesday.
body: Afrobeats star Davido has treated himself to a luxury vehicle to mark his 34th birthday, reportedly spending about $2.1 million on a Brabus XLP 800 Adventure Mercedes G 66.
## The car
A video posted on Instagram on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, showed Davido taking his new car for a spin.
## The birthday

Davido, whose full name is David Adeleke, turned 34 on Saturday, 21 November. His wife Chioma and members of his 30BG crew surprised him with a cake on his private jet, and family and friends threw him a surprise party when he landed. He and Chioma were also named on Rolling Stone Africa's Power Couple 50 list.
## Never stop helping
In another clip that surfaced this week, the singer said he would never stop helping people, despite experiences of betrayal.

stories.h: SEC approves share allocation for oversubscribed Dangote Refinery IPO
stories.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission has approved the share allocation plan for Dangote Refinery's initial public offering. Demand reportedly reached about three times the shares on offer.
body: Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved the share allocation plan for Dangote Petroleum Refinery's initial public offering (IPO), moving the company closer to listing on the stock market.
## The approval
The approval was granted on Monday, 23 November 2026, and marks a key milestone for the refinery and the investors who took part in the offer, which closed in October.
## Strong demand
Demand for the shares reportedly reached about three times the original offer size, reflecting strong interest in owning a stake in one of Africa's largest industrial projects.
## What happens next
With the allocation plan approved, the refinery moves closer to its stock market debut.

stories.h: Toyin Abraham and crew kneel to welcome Pete Edochie on her film set
stories.p: Actress Toyin Abraham and her crew reportedly went down on their knees to welcome veteran actor Pete Edochie to her film set. She also greeted him with Igbo chants.
body: Nollywood actress Toyin Abraham has drawn praise online after a video showed her welcoming veteran actor Pete Edochie to her film set.
## The welcome
The clip, posted on Abraham's Instagram page on Monday, 23 November 2026, captured the moment she and her crew dropped to their knees as Edochie stepped out of his vehicle.
After the greeting, Abraham launched into Igbo chants in the actor's honour, and a praise singer believed to be part of the crew joined in, singing the veteran star's praises in Igbo.
## How fans reacted
Many viewers praised the actress for the respect she showed the Nollywood icon.
## Background
Pete Edochie, one of Nollywood's most respected veterans, was in the news this week after speaking about his son, Yul Edochie.

stories.h: Bandits kill two teachers and abduct 13 people in Zamfara
stories.p: Suspected bandits have killed two teachers and abducted 13 people in separate attacks in Maru Local Government Area of Zamfara State, police say. Security teams are pursuing the attackers.
body: Suspected bandits have killed two teachers and abducted 13 people in separate attacks on communities in Zamfara State, according to the police.
## The attacks

The attacks took place in Jabaka and Tungar Janbuzu villages in Maru Local Government Area. In Jabaka, the gunmen reportedly invaded in large numbers and abducted 13 residents, including children. In Tungar Janbuzu, two teachers, both aged 35, were ambushed and killed while working on their farms.
## Police response

Force spokesman CSP Ani Iniedu, who disclosed the attacks on Monday, 23 November 2026, said police tactical teams, soldiers, local vigilantes and hunters had been deployed and were on the trail of the bandits to rescue the victims and arrest those responsible.
## Background
Zamfara is one of the North-West states worst hit by banditry and kidnapping. Maru is also the area where an APC campaign rally was called off this week after supporters died in a road crash.

13 people, including children, were abducted.

stories.h: US adds 24 more Nigerians to 'worst of the worst' deportation list
stories.p: The US Department of Homeland Security has reportedly added 24 Nigerians to its list of foreign nationals arrested for serious crimes, bringing the number of Nigerians on it to 157. The allegations range from fraud to drug offences.
body: The United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has reportedly added 24 Nigerians to its deportation list, bringing the total number of Nigerian nationals named to 157.
## The list

DHS updated its 'Worst of the Worst' initiative on Monday, 23 November 2026. The list identifies foreign nationals arrested by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) for what it describes as serious crimes, and now includes more than 45,000 people.
## The allegations

The people listed face allegations ranging from drug and weapons offences and violent crimes to fraud and the misuse of public benefits. Many of the Nigerians named were arrested over alleged wire fraud, mail fraud or impersonation in states including Texas, Virginia, New Jersey, Georgia and Indiana.
## Background
Being named on the list does not mean a person has been convicted.
more: 24 more Nigerians were added on 23 November.

stories.h: 15 APC supporters killed in road crash on way to Zamfara campaign flag-off
stories.p: Fifteen APC supporters died in a road crash while travelling from Gummi to the party's campaign flag-off in Talata-Mafara, Zamfara State. The party has called off a rally planned for Maru.
body: More than ten members of the All Progressives Congress (APC) have reportedly died in a road crash in Zamfara State, shortly after attending the party's governorship campaign flag-off in Talata-Mafara.
## What happened
The victims were travelling back to Gummi Local Government Area after the rally when the accident occurred. Several other people were injured.
## Government response

Zamfara's Commissioner for Information and Culture confirmed the deaths in a statement on Monday, 23 November 2026, and said the state government had sent condolences to the victims' families and the wider APC family. As a mark of respect, the government announced the suspension of a campaign rally.
## Background
The tragedy came on the same day that four people were killed in an attack on an NDC campaign event in Delta State.
## Toll rises to 15

The APC's Zamfara campaign council later put the death toll at 15, saying the victims were travelling from Gummi to Talata-Mafara for the flag-off when the crash happened. It called off a rally planned for Maru Local Government Area on Tuesday as a mark of respect, and pledged support for the injured and the bereaved families.
more: The victims were returning to Gummi.
Several others were injured.

stories.h: INEC warns 'rig and die' slogan could endanger polling staff and voters
stories.p: INEC has cautioned politicians and supporters against the popular 'rig and die' slogan ahead of 2027. A national commissioner said linking an electoral offence to death could incite mob attacks at polling units.
body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has warned political actors and their supporters against using the slogan 'rig and die' ahead of the 2027 general elections.
## What INEC said

Speaking on Monday, 23 November 2026, at a media engagement in Abuja on ethical election reporting, National Commissioner Mohammed Haruna, represented by an INEC official, said that whatever its originators intended, a slogan that links an electoral offence to death is dangerous. He warned that it could encourage mob attacks at voting centres.
## Who is at risk
The commissioner reportedly stressed that ordinary voters and ad-hoc election staff at polling units, rather than senior politicians, are the most physically exposed if such slogans lead to violence.
## Background

The phrase has become widely repeated on social media and at rallies, with some saying it is aimed only at those who would rig the vote. INEC's warning comes amid growing concern about election-related violence, including Monday's deadly attack on an NDC campaign event in Delta State.
more: INEC says the slogan could incite mob attacks.
Polling staff and voters are most at risk.

stories.h: Tinubu formally declares for second term, claims Otti and four South-East states back him
stories.p: At a town hall with Igbo leaders in Lagos, President Tinubu formally declared he is seeking a second term. He also claimed Imo, Enugu, Ebonyi and Anambra, as well as Abia Governor Alex Otti, are with him.
body: President Bola Tinubu has formally declared his intention to seek a second term, while claiming the support of Abia State Governor Alex Otti and four South-East states.
## The declaration

Tinubu spoke on Monday, 23 November 2026, at a town hall meeting with Igbo leaders, traders and youths, organised by the Ndigbo National Dialogue and Development Initiatives at the Wole Soyinka Centre for Culture and the Creative Arts in Iganmu, Lagos. He said the constitution allowed him to ask for a second term and that he wanted one, adding that the large turnout made him happy.
He framed his appeal around national unity, saying no Nigerian chose their ethnicity and all citizens share a common destiny.
## The South-East claim

The president listed Imo, Enugu, Ebonyi and Anambra as states he said were firmly behind him, and singled out Governor Otti, who was elected on the Labour Party platform, as a supporter. He said the absence of some of those he named from the event should not be read as displeasure.
## The other side
No response from Governor Otti was included in the reports. The South-East is widely regarded as a stronghold of the NDC's Peter Obi, who is from Anambra State.
more: Tinubu formally declared at a town hall in Lagos.
He claimed four South-East states and Otti back him.

stories.h: Wike mocks Peter Obi's 'Obi Kererenke' chant in viral video
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly been filmed singing and dancing to the 'Obi Kererenke' chant while ridiculing Peter Obi's supporters. He described it as a children's rain song.
body: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has drawn attention online after a video showed him singing and dancing to 'Obi Kererenke', a popular chant used by supporters of NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi.
## What he said

In the clip, Wike is said to have mocked the excitement around the tune, recalling that it was simply a song children sang while playing in the rain. He reportedly ridiculed the idea that it could carry Obi to the presidency.
## Background

The video follows recent remarks by Wike at events in Rivers State, where he repeatedly downplayed Obi's chances in 2027 and claimed he had neutralised the 'Obi Kererenke' wave. Wike, a former PDP governor, is now one of President Bola Tinubu's leading backers.
## The other side
No response from Obi or the NDC was included in the reports.

stories.h: Eguavoen reportedly tipped to take interim charge of Super Eagles as Chelle's deal nears end
stories.p: Augustine Eguavoen is reportedly the leading candidate to take temporary charge of the Super Eagles in early 2027. Eric Chelle's contract runs out in January, and the NFF's interim committee cannot sign long-term deals.
body: Former Super Eagles captain and coach Augustine Eguavoen is reportedly emerging as the leading candidate to take interim charge of Nigeria's national team in early 2027.
## Chelle's contract

Eric Chelle was appointed in January 2025 on a two-year deal that expires in January 2027. He had reportedly agreed in principle on an extension to August 2028, but the deal was never formally signed after NFF President Ibrahim Gusau and his board resigned and federation elections were postponed.
## Limited powers

A five-member FIFA Normalisation Committee is now running the federation until new elections, due by 31 May 2027. It is said to lack the authority to commit the NFF to multi-year contracts that go beyond its temporary mandate, leaving Chelle likely to leave when his current deal ends.
## Qualifying pressure
The uncertainty comes as Nigeria sit in a difficult position in their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying group.
more: Chelle's contract ends in January 2027.
The NFF's interim committee cannot sign long deals.
Eguavoen has led the team on an interim basis before.

stories.h: Fire breaks out at Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith's Calabasas estate
stories.p: A fire destroyed a maintenance shed on Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith's $42 million Calabasas estate early on Monday. No one was hurt and officials said the cause was accidental.
body: A fire broke out early on Monday, 23 November 2026, at Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith's $42 million estate in Calabasas, California.
## What happened

Sheriff's deputies were called shortly after midnight when security staff reported flames on the 150-acre property. They found a maintenance shed fully ablaze. Firefighters spent about two hours putting out the fire, which officials said did not spread to any other buildings.
## No injuries
A sheriff's spokesperson said no one was injured and that the cause of the fire was accidental.
## Background
It is the latest in a string of fires to affect the family's properties over the past eight years. Their biggest loss came in January 2025, when the Palisades Fire tore through parts of Malibu.
more: A maintenance shed on the estate burned down.
No one was injured.

stories.h: FIFA confirms US-led bid for 2031 Women's World Cup, UK to host 2035
stories.p: FIFA has confirmed the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica as hosts of the 2031 Women's World Cup, the first with 48 teams. The four UK nations will host the 2035 edition.
body: FIFA has officially named the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica as joint hosts of the 2031 Women's World Cup, while England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland will host the 2035 tournament.
## The decision

The hosts were confirmed on Monday, 23 November 2026, at an Extraordinary FIFA Congress held virtually with representatives of its 211 member associations. Both joint bids were approved by acclamation, having been the only candidates.
## A bigger tournament
The 2031 edition will be the first Women's World Cup with 48 teams and 104 matches, bringing it in line with the men's tournament, and the first to be hosted across four countries.
It will be the third time the US has hosted the Women's World Cup, after 1999 and 2003, and the first time for Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica.
more: 2031 will be the first 48-team Women's World Cup.
The four UK nations will host in 2035.

stories.h: Four killed as gunmen attack Omo-Agege's NDC campaign in Delta
stories.p: Gunmen opened fire on former Deputy Senate President Ovie Omo-Agege and his campaign team in Uduere, Ughelli North, Delta State, on Monday. His campaign says four people were killed and four others critically injured, and that the senator escaped unhurt.
body: Four people were killed and several others injured when gunmen attacked a Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) campaign event in Uduere, Ughelli North Local Government Area of Delta State, on Monday, 23 November 2026.
## What happened

According to his campaign organisation, armed men opened fire at close range on former Deputy Senate President Ovie Omo-Agege, the NDC's Delta Central senatorial candidate, and his entourage while he was addressing a crowd that had gathered to welcome him. The campaign said the senator was not hit, although bullets passed close to him.
## The victims
The Omo-Agege Campaign Organisation said four people died and four others were critically injured and receiving treatment. It named two of the dead as aides of the campaign.
## 'Assassination attempt'

In a statement by its media adviser, the campaign described the incident as a targeted attempt on the senator's life rather than a political clash, citing eyewitnesses who said the attackers made clear he was their target.
## What happens next
There was no word in the reports on arrests or a police statement. The attack comes as campaigns for the 2027 elections gather pace.
## Omo-Agege speaks

In a television interview on Monday night, Omo-Agege said the gunmen started shooting less than five minutes after he began addressing supporters, and that they shouted his name. He said a chance movement, stepping to the side of his vehicle to keep eye contact with the crowd, saved his life.
## Reactions

NDC chieftain Pat Utomi condemned the attack, saying violence would not cow Delta residents, and accused the ruling party of being behind political violence in the state. No response from the APC to that claim was included in the reports.
## IGP orders probe

On Tuesday, the Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Disu, ordered the Delta State Police Command to begin an impartial investigation. Preliminary police reports put the death toll at six. The police said the probe would also examine the conduct of officers deployed to the venue, and that anyone found culpable would be prosecuted.
more: Four people were killed and four critically injured.

The campaign calls it an assassination attempt.

stories.h: Tinubu tells Igbo leaders in Lagos he was upset over 2023 votes but they have settled
stories.p: President Tinubu reportedly told Igbo stakeholders in Lagos that he was angry that some of them did not vote for him in 2023, but said the matter had been settled. He urged them to collect their PVCs and vote for him on 16 January.
body: President Bola Tinubu has reportedly told Igbo leaders and stakeholders in Lagos that he expects their votes in the coming presidential election.
## What he said

Speaking in an informal tone at a meeting on Monday, 23 November 2026, the president acknowledged that some of those present did not vote for him in 2023. He said he had been upset about it at the time, but that both sides had since settled their differences.
He urged them to register, collect their Permanent Voter Cards and vote on 16 January, reminding them of what he described as an agreement between them, and stressing that he is the APC's candidate.
## Background
Lagos has a large Igbo population. The NDC's Peter Obi is among Tinubu's main challengers for 2027.
more: Tinubu said he was upset over 2023 but they have settled.

stories.h: Democrats win biggest US House majority in more than three decades
stories.p: US Democrats now hold 258 of 435 House seats after a recount in North Carolina, their largest majority since 1992. They also won the Senate in this month's midterm elections.
body: The Democratic Party has secured its largest majority in the US House of Representatives in more than 30 years, according to media projections.
## The deciding race

US networks projected on Sunday, 22 November 2026, that Democrat Chuck Hubbard had defeated Republican incumbent Virginia Foxx in North Carolina after a recount requested by Foxx. The win gives Democrats 258 seats in the 435-member chamber, matching the number they won in 1992, the year Bill Clinton was elected president. Hubbard said Foxx had conceded and thanked her for her decades of service.
House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries celebrated on X, saying the party now held the largest majority of any party in Congress this century.
## Senate too
Democrats also won control of the Senate in this month's midterm elections, a major setback for President Donald Trump and the Republican Party.
## What it means

Control of both chambers gives Democrats more power to block Trump's legislative agenda and launch investigations during the final two years of his presidency. The results were widely seen as reflecting voter frustration over living costs, tariffs and the conflict with Iran.
more: Democrats now hold 258 House seats.
They also won control of the Senate.

stories.h: Medical academy urges Nigerians to take precautions against new COVID variant PJ.2.1
stories.p: The Academy of Medical Sciences of Nigeria has warned that festive travel and gatherings could spread a new COVID-19 variant, PJ.2.1. The WHO says the global risk is low and there is no evidence it causes more severe illness.
body: The Academy of Medical Sciences of Nigeria has advised Nigerians to take precautions against a new COVID-19 variant, PJ.2.1, warning that festive season travel and large gatherings could help it spread.
## What the advisory says

In a public health advisory signed by its president and the chair of its rapid response committee, the Academy said the World Health Organization has classified PJ.2.1 as a Variant Under Monitoring, while rating its additional global public health risk as low. It stressed that evidence about the variant is still limited.
## Where it has been found

The variant was first detected in Ontario, Canada, on 2 May 2026, and has since been reported in countries including the United States, Spain, France, the Netherlands, Israel, Singapore, Brazil, Argentina, Australia and New Zealand. WHO had recorded sequences from 18 countries as of 8 November.
## How serious is it?

Early studies suggest PJ.2.1, a descendant of the Omicron JN.1 family, may spread more efficiently than some other Omicron sub-lineages. However, there is currently no evidence that it causes more severe illness, and early laboratory findings suggest antibodies from updated COVID-19 vaccines can neutralise it.
more: WHO rates the global risk as low.
It may spread faster but is not more severe.
Updated vaccines appear to work against it.

stories.h: Thousands evacuated from Don Toliver concert in Manchester after unknown substance released
stories.p: Police declared a major incident at Manchester's Co-op Live arena after an unknown substance made concertgoers unwell during a Don Toliver show. More than 50 people were assessed and one was taken to hospital.
body: Thousands of fans were evacuated from Manchester's Co-op Live arena on Sunday night after an unknown substance reportedly made several concertgoers unwell.
## What happened

About 12,000 people were at a performance by American rapper Don Toliver, part of the UK leg of his Octane World Tour, when emergency services were called. Greater Manchester Police declared a major incident after reports of people falling ill in the crowd.
## The response

The ambulance service said it assessed more than 50 people, some of whom reported eye and breathing symptoms, and decontamination was carried out at the venue. Police said on Monday that several people were treated at the scene and one was taken to hospital.
## Investigation
Officers said they were working to find out what the substance was. The arena, which describes itself as the UK's largest indoor entertainment venue, said it was cooperating with the police.
more: About 12,000 fans were at the show.
More than 50 people were assessed.
Police are trying to identify the substance.

stories.h: APC says letter asking INEC to guarantee Tinubu's 2027 win is fake
stories.p: The APC has dismissed a letter circulating online that claimed its national chairman asked INEC to ensure President Tinubu is declared winner in 2027. The party called it fake and malicious.
body: The All Progressives Congress (APC) has rejected a letter circulating on social media that claimed to be from its National Chairman, Professor Nentawe Yilwatda, asking the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to guarantee President Bola Tinubu's victory in the 2027 election.
## What the letter claimed

The document, dated 22 November 2026 and addressed to INEC Chairman Professor Joash Amupitan, purported to ask the commission to use its administrative and operational machinery to make sure Tinubu was declared winner of the next presidential election.
## The party's response

In a statement on Monday, the chairman's special adviser on media described the letter as fake and malicious, and a calculated attempt to damage the reputation of the party's leadership and weaken trust in democratic institutions. The party said the letter did not come from Yilwatda or his office, and pointed to features missing from the document that would appear on genuine correspondence.
## Background
The row comes as campaigns for the January 2027 elections intensify.

stories.h: Tinubu asks Sunday Igboho to deploy his security network in the South-West
stories.p: President Tinubu reportedly asked activist Sunday Igboho to use his Iru Ekun Security Network to help protect lives and property in the South-West. The two met briefly in the president's car after the Ibadan rally.
body: President Bola Tinubu has reportedly asked Yoruba nation activist Sunday Adeyemo, popularly known as Sunday Igboho, to deploy his Iru Ekun Security Network to help protect lives and property across South-West Nigeria.
## The meeting

According to a statement released on Monday, 23 November 2026, by Igboho's media office in Ibadan, the two met briefly inside the president's official car after the APC presidential campaign rally at Mapo Hall, Ibadan, on Saturday.
## What was discussed
The meeting is said to have focused on the work of Iru Ekun, a community security outfit founded by Igboho, and how its members could help reduce insecurity in rural and urban areas of the region.
## Background
Igboho is a well-known campaigner for Yoruba self-determination. The meeting took place on the day of Tinubu's campaign rally in Ibadan, where the president also met traditional rulers.

stories.p: Nigeria's High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, has rejected social media claims that he was recalled or reprimanded. He said he was in Abuja for routine consultations.

stories.p: Leroy Boseman, father of the late Black Panther actor Chadwick Boseman, has reportedly died after a brief illness. His family described him as a beloved husband and father.
body: Leroy Boseman, the father of the late Hollywood actor Chadwick Boseman, has died after a brief illness, according to reports.

stories.h: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive
stories.p: Nvidia's board has unanimously voted to bring back Jensen Huang as president, chief executive and board member, weeks after he stepped down amid a controversy. The board said US government input assured it his return posed no national security risk.
body: Nvidia's board of directors has reinstated Jensen Huang as president, chief executive and a member of the board with immediate effect, the company announced on Monday, 23 November 2026.
## The decision

The board said it voted unanimously after a series of discussions with Huang. It said it had received input from senior levels of the United States government and, based on that, was confident that his return posed no national security risk.
The board chair said Huang was the right person to lead the company and that his return was in the best interests of shareholders, employees, partners and customers.
## Background

Huang co-founded Nvidia and built it into one of the world's most valuable companies on the back of demand for its AI chips. He stepped down earlier this month amid a controversy over his personal conduct.
## Shares surge
Nvidia's shares jumped 33% after the announcement. President Donald Trump backed the decision, saying he had been in contact with the board and had spoken with Huang.

stories.h: Abure-led Labour Party faction endorses Tinubu for 2027
stories.p: The Labour Party faction led by Julius Abure has reportedly endorsed President Tinubu for re-election. Abure said the faction would mobilise the votes the party won in 2023 behind the president.
body: A faction of the Labour Party led by Julius Abure has reportedly endorsed President Bola Tinubu for re-election in the 2027 general election.
## The endorsement

Abure announced the decision on Monday, 23 November 2026, after a meeting of the faction's National Executive Council in Abuja. The faction is said to have described Tinubu as the most suitable candidate to lead Nigeria beyond 2027, pointing to his political experience and his time as governor of Lagos State.
Abure also reportedly pledged to mobilise the six million votes the Labour Party claims it won in the 2023 presidential election in support of the president.
## Background

Earlier this month, Abure said he would not support Peter Obi, the party's 2023 presidential candidate, who is now running on the NDC platform. He had said he was open to working with either Tinubu or Atiku Abubakar, depending on how the party's leadership dispute was resolved. The Labour Party has been split by a long-running leadership tussle.
## How people reacted
The endorsement drew criticism and sarcastic comments on social media, with many users questioning the faction's motives.
## 'It may have been an error'

In a television interview on Monday, Abure said promoting Obi as the party's candidate in 2023 may have been a mistake, and criticised Obi as unreliable over how he treated the party's leadership. Obi left the Labour Party on 31 December 2025 amid the leadership dispute. No response from Obi was included in the reports.
more: The decision was taken at a NEC meeting in Abuja.

stories.h: Infantino says Nigeria is not ready to host a World Cup yet
stories.p: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has reportedly said Nigeria cannot yet host the World Cup because of gaps in stadiums, airports and transport. He added that the country has the building blocks to get there.
body: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has reportedly said Nigeria is not currently ready to host the FIFA World Cup.
## What he said

Speaking during his visit to Nigeria, Infantino was asked whether the country could stage a tournament of that size. He is said to have pointed to serious shortfalls in stadiums, airports and transport networks as the main obstacles, and explained the kind of infrastructure any host nation must have in place.
## Hope for the future

However, he reportedly did not rule out Nigeria's long-term chances, saying the country has the building blocks needed to eventually meet the standard. He also described the national training facilities he visited in Abuja and Warri as impressive.
## Background
South Africa remains the only sub-Saharan African country to have hosted the World Cup, in 2010, while Morocco will co-host the 2030 edition with Spain and Portugal.
## How fans reacted
His comments drew mixed reactions from Nigerian football fans online.

stories.h: Tyson Fury reveals he was diagnosed with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder
stories.p: Former heavyweight champion Tyson Fury has reportedly revealed he was diagnosed with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder after a severe mental health crisis. He speaks about it in an upcoming Netflix documentary.
body: Former world heavyweight boxing champion Tyson Fury has reportedly revealed that he was diagnosed with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder after a severe mental health crisis.
## The documentary

The 38-year-old British boxer opens up about his struggles in an upcoming Netflix documentary titled Fury, which looks at his life, career and personal battles. It features interviews with Fury, his wife Paris and his father John.
## His crisis

Fury and his wife recalled how, after he was hospitalised with a suspected heart attack in June 2016, he began hearing threatening voices. At the time he had sunk into depression and was struggling with drugs and alcohol. He described that period as an indescribable darkness and said he feared he would end up locked away.
## Background
Fury has previously spoken publicly about his battle with bipolar disorder.

stories.h: CAF adopts Kiswahili as its fifth official language
stories.p: African football's governing body has added Kiswahili to its official languages alongside English, French, Arabic and Portuguese. The decision was taken at CAF's General Assembly in Abuja.
body: The Confederation of African Football (CAF) has adopted Kiswahili as its fifth official language, alongside English, French, Arabic and Portuguese.
## The decision

The change was approved at CAF's 48th Ordinary General Assembly, held in Abuja on Saturday, 21 November 2026. CAF described it as a historic decision that reflects its commitment to Africa's linguistic and cultural diversity, and said it would strengthen the place of African languages in football administration.
## Who pushed for it

The proposal was championed by the Tanzania Football Federation, with backing from the football bodies of Kenya and Uganda. CAF President Patrice Motsepe congratulated the three East African countries.
## About Kiswahili
Kiswahili is spoken by more than 200 million people, mainly in Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda, and is also widely used in other parts of East, Central and Southern Africa.

stories.h: CAS to rule on Tuesday on who won AFCON 2025, Senegal or Morocco
stories.p: The Court of Arbitration for Sport will announce its decision on the disputed 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final on Tuesday, 24 November. Senegal won the match on the pitch, but CAF later handed the title to Morocco.
body: The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) will deliver its long-awaited ruling on the disputed 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final between Senegal and Morocco on Tuesday, 24 November 2026.
## The announcement

CAS confirmed on Monday that all the parties had been notified of the decision date. The ruling is expected on Tuesday afternoon and will settle which country is officially recognised as champion. The court reminded the public that only information released through its own channels should be treated as official.
## How the dispute started

The final was played in Rabat on 18 January 2026. Senegal beat hosts Morocco 1-0 after extra time, with Pape Gueye scoring the winner. But the match was marred by chaotic scenes when Senegal's players briefly walked off the pitch in protest at a late penalty awarded to Morocco. When play resumed after about 15 minutes, Brahim Diaz's attempted Panenka penalty was saved by Senegal goalkeeper Edouard Mendy.
## Title stripped

On 17 March, CAF's Appeal Board overturned the result, ruling that Senegal had forfeited the match by leaving the pitch, and awarded the title to Morocco. The Senegalese Football Federation rejected the decision and took the case to CAS, naming CAF and the Royal Moroccan Football Federation as respondents.
## What happens next
Tuesday's decision is final at the sporting level and will either restore Senegal's title or confirm Morocco as champions.
more: The ruling is due on Tuesday, 24 November.

stories.h: Zelensky says Ukrainian sea drones sank a Russian warship in Libya
stories.p: Ukraine says its naval drones sank a Russian corvette docked in Benghazi, Libya, and hit a Russian cargo ship off North Africa. President Zelensky released video of the operation on Monday.
body: Ukrainian naval drones have reportedly sunk a modern Russian warship docked in the eastern Libyan port of Benghazi and struck a Russian cargo ship off the North African coast, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Monday, 23 November 2026.
## The operation

In a statement on Telegram, released alongside video footage, Zelensky said Ukrainian forces used seven domestically made unmanned surface vessels to attack the corvette Merkury. The ship, commissioned in May 2023 and built with radar-evading features, caught fire and sank, and a combat helicopter on board was destroyed. Satellite images later reportedly showed the vessel capsized and mostly underwater beside the pier.
Zelensky described it as an exemplary operation in response to Russia's war and thanked Ukraine's Security Service and defence forces, saying the targets set had been achieved.
## Why it matters
The strike marks a major expansion of Ukraine's attacks at sea, far beyond the Black Sea, where its drones have previously targeted Russian ships.
## Russia's response
No response from Moscow was included in the initial reports.
more: Seven Ukrainian sea drones were reportedly used.

stories.h: Abba Yusuf claims Kwankwaso once sent him to promise Tinubu they would join APC
stories.p: Kano Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has reportedly claimed that Rabiu Kwankwaso sent him to tell President Tinubu they would return to the APC if the Supreme Court upheld his 2023 victory. Kwankwaso has not responded to the claim in reports.
body: Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has reportedly claimed that his former political mentor, Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, sent him to President Bola Tinubu after the 2023 governorship election to promise that they would return to the All Progressives Congress (APC).
## The claim

Speaking in a Hausa-language interview on Sunday, 22 November 2026, Yusuf is said to have explained the background to his defection from the NNPP to the APC in January 2026. He claimed Kwankwaso asked him to tell Tinubu that they would join the ruling party if the Supreme Court upheld his victory over the APC's Nasir Yusuf Gawuna, and was even willing for him to swear on the Qur'an to show the promise was serious.
Yusuf also reportedly alleged that Kwankwaso held several meetings with Tinubu and sent delegations to discuss the arrangement.
## Background

Yusuf and Kwankwaso, once close allies, have since split. Kwankwaso is now the running mate to Peter Obi on the NDC presidential ticket, while Yusuf is in the APC. In the same interview, the governor spoke about the end of his marriage to Kwankwaso's niece, Zainab.
## The other side
No response from Kwankwaso or the NDC to the claim was included in the reports.
## The timeline

According to the governor, the visit to Tinubu took place while his 2023 victory was being challenged in court by the APC's candidate, and the aim was to assure the president that they would join the APC if he let the case run its course without interference. Yusuf defected to the APC on 26 January 2026.

stories.h: Crowd at Obi-Kwankwaso rally in Onitsha shuts down Flavour song
stories.p: Supporters at an NDC rally in Onitsha reportedly rejected Flavour's hit Baby Oku when a DJ played it in place of the Obi-Kwankwaso campaign song. A video of the moment has gone viral.

## What happened

The rally, held on 21 November 2026 in support of NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi and his running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso, was dominated by a Hausa-language Obi-Kwankwaso campaign song, which supporters were dancing and chanting to.

When the DJ suddenly changed to the highlife track by Flavour, whose real name is Chinedu Okoli, the crowd is said to have shut it down immediately and kept up the pressure until the DJ went back to the campaign song.
## How people reacted
A video of the moment spread quickly on social media, drawing a wide range of comments as campaigns for the 2027 elections heat up.

stories.p: Davido was reportedly surprised with a cake on his private jet and then a party organised by family and friends for his 34th birthday. His wife Chioma said she enjoyed the celebration.
body: Afrobeats star Davido has marked his 34th birthday with a series of surprises, according to reports.
## On the jet

Before landing, the singer was reportedly given an early birthday treat by his wife, Chioma, and members of his 30BG crew, who surprised him on his private jet with a cake and a chorus of Happy Birthday.
## The surprise party

Neither Davido nor Chioma is said to have known that a bigger celebration awaited them. On arrival, the couple walked into a surprise party arranged by family and close friends. Guests included socialite Cubana Chiefpriest and Davido's cousin Nikos Living, along with other well-known figures.
## What Chioma said
Speaking to the press with Davido beside her after the event, Chioma said she thoroughly enjoyed the celebration. She had earlier shared rare pregnancy photos to celebrate her husband's birthday.
## Power couple list

Davido and Chioma were also named on Rolling Stone Africa's first Power Couple 50 list, published on 20 November, which ranks African and diaspora couples on global influence, social impact, creativity and business.

stories.h: GehGeh withdraws support for Delta Governor Oborevwori, cites mother's death
stories.p: Social commentator GehGeh has reportedly withdrawn his endorsement of Delta State Governor Sheriff Oborevwori. He blamed poor healthcare in his community for his mother's death and said Peter Obi remains his presidential choice.
body: Social commentator and content creator GehGeh has reportedly withdrawn his earlier support for Delta State Governor Sheriff Oborevwori's re-election bid.
## His reasons

GehGeh said he lost his mother on 8 December 2024, and blamed the lack of adequate healthcare facilities in his community and neighbouring areas as a major cause of her death. He said he was ashamed to have previously endorsed the governor and asked his followers to forgive him.
He also questioned what the state government was doing to tackle youth unemployment.
## His presidential choice
GehGeh added that Peter Obi of the NDC remains his preferred presidential candidate for 2027.

stories.h: Eight soldiers and 13 workers were killed while rebuilding Borno community, officials say
stories.p: Borno officials have revealed that eight soldiers, including a major, and 13 construction workers were killed by insurgents during the 14-month rebuilding of Mayanti in Bama. Governor Babagana Zulum has now inaugurated 500 houses and a school there.
body: At least 21 people, including eight soldiers and 13 construction workers, were reportedly killed by insurgents during the reconstruction of the Mayanti community in Bama Local Government Area of Borno State.
## How it came to light

The deaths were disclosed on Saturday, 21 November 2026, by Borno's Commissioner for Education, Abba Wakilbe, who heads the community's resettlement committee, during the inauguration of the rebuilt community. Among those killed was a major, Major Mairiga, along with seven other soldiers.
Wakilbe said work on the project began in August 2025 and was completed in October 2026. He paid tribute to those who died, saying their sacrifice made the return of the community possible.
## What was built

Governor Babagana Zulum inaugurated 500 houses, 2,000 semi-permanent shelters and a school at Mayanti. He praised the committee for finishing the project despite repeated attacks, recalling that the community was attacked four or five times while construction was going on.
## Background
Many communities in Borno State were destroyed during years of insurgency, and the state government has been rebuilding and resettling displaced residents in several areas.
more: Major Mairiga was among the soldiers killed.

Zulum inaugurated 500 houses and a school.

stories.h: Akpabio targets two million Akwa Ibom votes for Tinubu as Tompolo donates 31 campaign vehicles
stories.p: Senate President Godswill Akpabio has reportedly said Akwa Ibom will give President Tinubu two million votes in 2027. At the same event in Uyo, a pro-Tinubu group backed by Tompolo received 31 campaign vehicles.
body: Senate President Godswill Akpabio has reportedly said Akwa Ibom State will give overwhelming support to President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 elections, setting a target of two million votes.
## The event

Akpabio spoke at Ibom Hall Ground in Uyo, where the PBAT Door-to-Door Movement inaugurated its Akwa Ibom executives. The movement's grand patron, former militant leader Government Ekpemupolo, known as Tompolo, donated 31 campaign vehicles and other campaign materials. He was represented by an executive of his security firm.
The vehicles are meant to cover all 31 local government areas of the state and support the movement's grassroots work.
## What was said
Akpabio is said to have praised the movement's growing grassroots presence. Its national coordinator described the Akwa Ibom inauguration as another milestone in its nationwide expansion.
## Background
Campaigns for the January 2027 elections are now under way across the country, with parties building grassroots support in the states.
## Abia next

The movement later inaugurated its Abia State chapter in Umuahia, where Tompolo's representative donated 25 campaign vehicles. Deputy Speaker Benjamin Kalu urged Abia and the wider South-East to back Tinubu's re-election.

stories.p: Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde has reportedly put President Tinubu's chances of re-election at 30 per cent, citing economic hardship and insecurity. The figure is his own estimate, not from a poll.
body: Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde has reportedly said President Bola Tinubu has only a 30 per cent chance of winning the 2027 presidential election.

Makinde is said to have argued that poor governance has worn away the goodwill the ruling APC once enjoyed. He pointed to food insecurity, the rising cost of living and insecurity as the main reasons he believes many Nigerians have turned against the party.
He also reportedly accused the APC leadership of dismissing citizens' concerns instead of addressing them.
## Not a poll
The 30 per cent figure is Makinde's own assessment and was not taken from any published opinion poll or independent survey.
## Background
Makinde is himself among the challengers in the race. His comments come days after Tinubu's APC held a campaign rally in Ibadan, the Oyo State capital.

stories.p: Gospel singer Frank Edwards has reportedly said he rejected an offer that could have made him rich enough to own three private jets. The promoters wanted him to replace the name Jesus with God in his songs.
body: Gospel singer Frank Edwards has reportedly opened up about a deal he rejected early in his career, which he believes could have made him wealthy enough to own three private jets.
## The offer

Speaking during a concert ministration, in a clip that circulated online on 21 November 2026, Edwards is said to have explained that the offer came shortly after he travelled to South Africa to shoot the video for his song Beautiful.

Promoters reportedly offered to take his music to a global audience on one condition: that he remove the name of Jesus from his songs and replace it with God, arguing that this would make the music more widely acceptable.
## His message

Edwards told his audience that the temptation came disguised as a genuine business opportunity, and warned that not every compromise looks obviously wrong at first. He said his mother's advice helped him turn the deal down.

stories.h: NCC warns 'London-used' phones may be cut off if they fail device checks
stories.p: Imported used phones flagged by the Nigerian Communications Commission could lose network service after 30 days, under its device checker rules. The regulator has been sending text alerts to affected users since October.
body: Nigerians who buy imported used phones, popularly called 'London-used', could reportedly lose mobile service if their devices fail checks by the Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC).
## How it works
Under the regulator's Device Checker and Type Approval Compliance framework, flagged devices may be disconnected from local networks after 30 cumulative days.

The NCC began sending text alerts under the sender name NCC-Checker on 10 October 2026. The messages advise affected users to contact the seller or check their device using the regulator's device checker. Alerts have reportedly gone to users of iPhones, Google Pixels, TECNO, Infinix and other brands.
## Existing phones
About 231 million devices that were already active on Nigerian networks before the rollout were captured automatically.

stories.h: Troops rescue 18 of 22 children abducted in Kaduna, search on for four
stories.p: Soldiers have rescued 18 children who were abducted by suspected terrorists in Kachia/Kajuru, Kaduna State, early on Sunday. The army says the search for the remaining four continues.
body: The Nigerian Army says its troops have rescued 18 children who were abducted by suspected terrorists in Kaduna State early on Sunday, 22 November 2026, and are searching for four others.
## What happened

According to the army, armed men intercepted 22 members of the Boys' and Girls' Brigade in the Mother-Cat community, in the Kachia/Kajuru area of the state, while they were on an early-morning group road walk, and took them away.
## The rescue

The army's acting director of public relations, Colonel Appolonia Anele, said troops of 1 Division operating under Operation FANSAN YAMMA moved immediately after receiving a distress call and pursued the abductors. Troops advanced towards a riverside area, where some of the children were found after the fleeing attackers abandoned them. In all, 18 were rescued.
## What happens next
The army said operations were continuing to rescue the remaining four children. The attack comes days after troops foiled a suspected kidnap attempt at a school in another part of Kaduna State.

stories.h: Defence Ministry deletes post promoting Tinubu's Ibadan rally after backlash
stories.p: The Ministry of Defence has reportedly removed a post from its official X account that publicised the APC presidential rally in Ibadan. Critics said it breached rules on the use of state resources in campaigns.
body: Nigeria's Ministry of Defence has reportedly taken down a post from its official social media accounts that promoted President Bola Tinubu's APC campaign rally in Ibadan, after a public outcry over the neutrality of state institutions.
## The post

The post, published on Saturday on the ministry's verified X account, announced the APC's re-election rally at Mapo Hall, Ibadan, and included photos showing campaign banners of Tinubu and Vice President Kashim Shettima. It said Defence Minister Christopher Musa had inspected the venue to check security and crowd-control arrangements ahead of the president's arrival.
## The criticism

Civic groups and opposition figures are said to have condemned the post, arguing that it went against the Electoral Act's ban on using state resources and public media to favour or disadvantage any party, as well as guidelines that require public institutions to remain neutral.
## Background

Tinubu held the rally in Ibadan on Saturday, 21 November 2026, where APC candidates in the South-West were endorsed. He later said he kept the event low-key out of respect for victims of the Bayelsa boat accident. The ministry was not reported to have commented on why the post was removed.
more: The post showed Tinubu and Shettima campaign banners.
Critics cited the Electoral Act's ban on using state resources.

stories.h: Tinubu says water supply went off in the Villa while he was shaving
stories.p: President Tinubu has reportedly said the Presidential Villa also suffers water cuts, recalling that supply stopped while he was shaving last week. He promised to fix the country's infrastructure problems.
body: President Bola Tinubu has reportedly said that the Presidential Villa in Abuja is not spared from the kind of utility problems many Nigerians face every day.
## What he said
Speaking in Lagos on Sunday, 22 November 2026, the president said the water supply at the Villa was cut off while he was shaving last Wednesday, and joked about the inconvenience it caused.

He is said to have promised that his administration would fix the country's infrastructure problems, saying there can be no development without power and water. He insisted that Nigeria has the capacity to overcome its challenges and that the government had only just started.
## Background
Poor water supply and unreliable electricity remain major complaints across Nigeria. The president's comments come as campaigns for the January 2027 elections get under way.
## The setting

He spoke at a prayer session organised by his family at the Yoruba Tennis Club in Onikan, Lagos, a day after the APC rally in Ibadan, and said the water went off on Wednesday, 18 November. He also urged party supporters in Lagos to step up voter mobilisation and to reconcile.
## Reactions
His comments drew mixed reactions online, with many critics mocking the promise to fix the problems, noting that the government has already been in office for several years.

stories.h: Correctional officers probed after two death-row inmates escape in Ilorin
stories.p: About 20 correctional officers are reportedly under investigation after two death-row inmates escaped from the Oke-Kura custodial centre in Ilorin. The service has confirmed the probe but not the number of officers involved.
body: About 20 officers of the Nigerian Correctional Service are reportedly under investigation after two death-row inmates escaped from the Medium Security Custodial Centre at Oke-Kura, Ilorin, Kwara State, last Wednesday.
## The probe

Those affected are said to include members of the armed squad and duty officers responsible for supervising inmates around the clock. Sources described the breach as a coordinated escape attempt involving seven inmates, two of whom got away.
## What the service said

The Kwara State Command of the service confirmed on Sunday, 22 November 2026, that an investigation had begun on the orders of the Controller-General of Corrections. Its spokesperson said the probe would be thorough, but declined to confirm how many officers had been questioned, saying it would be premature while the investigation was ongoing.

stories.p: Veteran actor Pete Edochie has reportedly praised his son Yul's composure despite years of criticism over his second marriage. He said neither Yul nor May has used interviews to blame the other.

stories.h: Patience Ozokwo and Ebele Okaro visit Joke Silva after Olu Jacobs' death
stories.p: Nollywood veterans Patience Ozokwo and Ebele Okaro have reportedly paid a condolence visit to Joke Silva at her home. Ozokwo had missed Olu Jacobs' funeral because she was working in Ghana.
body: Nollywood veterans Patience Ozokwo and Ebele Okaro have reportedly visited their colleague Joke Silva at home to offer condolences over the death of her husband, the legendary actor Olu Jacobs.
## The visit

Ozokwo shared a video of the visit on social media on Sunday, 22 November 2026. It showed her signing the condolence register before Joke Silva walked in to welcome the two actresses. In her caption, Ozokwo said she was grateful to be able to spend time with her colleague during such a difficult period.
## Why she missed the funeral

Olu Jacobs was buried in Lagos on 2 October 2026, at a service attended by family, friends and many colleagues from the entertainment industry. Ozokwo had earlier explained that she could not attend the burial because she was in Ghana on a work engagement.

stories.h: Veteran actor Don Richard appeals to leaders for help in viral video
stories.p: Nollywood actor Don Richard has appealed to governors, senators, ministers and other public figures for financial help. In a video, he said life in Nigeria is hard and that he is only a bad person in films.
body: Veteran Nollywood actor Don Richard (Donrichard Oguntimehin) has appealed to the public for help in a video that is now circulating widely online.
## His appeal

Speaking in Yoruba, the actor said life in Nigeria is hard and asked people who have been blessed to remember him. He directly addressed commissioners, ministers, senators, governors, local government chairmen and other influential people, asking them to have mercy on him and lift him up.
He also told viewers that he is not a bad person and is only bad in the movies, a reference to the villain roles he is known for.
more: He appealed to governors, senators and ministers.
He said he is only bad in the movies.
Fans are urging people to help him.

stories.h: Pochettino's Man United reign starts with 4-0 thrashing at Liverpool
stories.p: Mauricio Pochettino's first game as Manchester United manager ended in a 4-0 defeat at Anfield after Lenny Yoro was sent off in the eighth minute. United are 19th in the Premier League.
body: Mauricio Pochettino's time in charge of Manchester United got off to a painful start on Sunday, 22 November 2026, as Liverpool beat his side 4-0 at Anfield.
## How the game went

United's plans fell apart early when defender Lenny Yoro was shown a red card in the eighth minute, leaving them with ten men for more than 80 minutes. Liverpool quickly took advantage. Dominik Szoboszlai opened the scoring in the 10th minute, and Florian Wirtz doubled the lead three minutes later.
Liverpool kept their two-goal lead until half-time and added two more after the break through Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz.
## Where it leaves the clubs
The result left United in 19th place, inside the Premier League relegation zone, while Liverpool moved into the top four.
## Pochettino's reaction
Speaking after the match, Pochettino reportedly admitted that the early red card shaped the game, but urged his players to turn their frustration into better performances in the coming matches.
## Background
Pochettino took over at Old Trafford only recently. The club has been linked with several players ahead of the January window, including Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey.
more: Lenny Yoro was sent off after eight minutes.
Szoboszlai, Wirtz, Ngumoha and Munoz scored.
United are 19th in the table.

stories.h: Nollywood actress Anike Sinleke dies after battle with ovarian cancer
stories.p: Nollywood actress Adenike Abike Babajide, known as Anike Sinleke, has reportedly died after battling ovarian cancer. Her death was announced on Sunday by an Instagram show host she was due to appear with that day.
body: Nollywood is mourning the death of actress Adenike Abike Babajide, popularly known as Anike Sinleke, who has reportedly died after a battle with ovarian cancer.
## How the news broke

The news emerged on Sunday, 22 November 2026, in a post by Bukola Fagbuyi, host of the Instagram live show Rubbin Minds With Bukky. Fagbuyi said the actress had been scheduled to appear as a guest on the programme that same day.
## Her career

Anike Sinleke learned her craft under the mentorship of veteran actor Remmy Shitta and worked on film sets with filmmaker Deji Adenuga. At one point she stepped away from acting to complete her Higher National Diploma.
Beyond the screen, she was known in Lagos entertainment and cultural circles for her role with the Sisi Eko beauty pageant, which started around 2011.
## Tributes
Fans and colleagues have taken to social media to mourn her, with many expressing shock at the news.
more: She had been due to appear on an Instagram show that day.
She was mentored by veteran actor Remmy Shitta.
She was linked with the Sisi Eko beauty pageant.

stories.h: Goodluck Jonathan says dishonest leaders have made Nigeria a laughing stock
stories.p: Former President Goodluck Jonathan has reportedly said broken promises by politicians have damaged Nigeria's global image. He called for credible elections and a political culture that rewards competence over money.
body: Former President Goodluck Jonathan has reportedly criticised Nigeria's political class, saying dishonest leadership and unkept campaign promises have hurt the country's standing in the world.
## Where he spoke
Jonathan gave the keynote address on Saturday, 21 November 2026, at the third Paul Alaje Colloquium, themed The Brand: Nigeria, at the NAF Conference Centre in Kado, Abuja.
## What he said

He is said to have lamented that Nigeria has lost much of the respect it once enjoyed internationally, and accused office holders of misleading citizens and acting against their public promises. He warned that continued dishonesty in public life would hold back the country's progress.

Jonathan reportedly called for reforms to how leaders are chosen, credible elections and real democracy within parties. He said the country needs a political culture that rewards ideas, character and competence rather than money, patronage and sectional interests.
## Background
Jonathan was president from 2010 to 2015. His remarks come as campaigns for the January 2027 elections get under way.
more: He spoke at a colloquium in Abuja on Saturday.
He called for credible elections.
He urged leaders to reward competence over money.

stories.h: Calvin Bassey confirms new contract talks with Fulham amid Man United links
stories.p: Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey has reportedly confirmed he is negotiating a new deal with Fulham. Manchester United and Inter Milan have been linked with him.
body: Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey has reportedly confirmed that he is in talks with Fulham over a new long-term contract.
## What he said

Speaking after Fulham's 1-1 draw with Manchester City at the Etihad Stadium on Saturday, the 26-year-old said negotiations were ongoing and that he would like a deal done quickly. He described Fulham as an amazing place to be and said the manager had shown great faith in him.
## Transfer interest
His comments come amid reports linking him with a January move to Manchester United under new head coach Mauricio Pochettino, as well as interest from Italian side Inter Milan.
## His contract
Bassey's current deal runs until next summer, although Fulham hold an option to extend it by a year. He captains the club under manager Álvaro Arbeloa.
## The result
Saturday's draw ended Fulham's run of 17 straight defeats against Manchester City.
more: Bassey says talks with Fulham are ongoing.
Man United and Inter Milan have been linked with him.
Fulham drew 1-1 at Man City.

stories.h: Paolo Bulgari, jeweller to royals and film stars, dies at 89
stories.p: Paolo Bulgari, the longtime chairman of the Bvlgari luxury group, has died in Rome at the age of 89. His family called him the greatest jeweller of our times.
body: Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's Roman workshop into a global luxury brand, has died in Rome at the age of 89.
## The announcement

His family announced his death on Saturday, 21 November 2026, describing him as an extraordinary entrepreneur who promoted Italian craftsmanship around the world. The cause of death was not disclosed. The Bvlgari brand also paid tribute to its former chairman.
## His life and work

Born in Rome in 1937, Bulgari joined the family firm in 1960 and became known as one of the leading experts on precious gemstones. He became chairman in 1984. The house was founded in 1884 by his grandfather, a Greek silversmith who settled in Rome.

Under Paolo and his brothers, the brand became known for bold designs, colourful gems and yellow gold, opened shops in Paris, New York and Geneva, and expanded into watches, perfumes, leather goods and hotels.
## Famous clients
During Rome's glamorous era of the 1950s and 1960s, the brand's flagship store became a favourite of royalty and film stars, including Sophia Loren and Audrey Hepburn.
more: He died in Rome at 89.
He became Bvlgari chairman in 1984.
Sophia Loren and Audrey Hepburn were clients.

stories.h: Gunmen reportedly set secondary school on fire in Plateau's Bokkos
stories.p: Suspected gunmen reportedly set fire to Government Secondary School, Masharkut, in Bokkos, Plateau State, on Sunday afternoon. No casualties were reported, and local officials said the attackers had not been identified.
body: Suspected gunmen reportedly set fire to Government Secondary School, Masharkut, in the Butura District of Bokkos Local Government Area, Plateau State, on Sunday, 22 November 2026, causing panic among residents.
## What happened

According to a community member, the attack began at about 1pm. Residents noticed smoke rising from the school shortly after returning from church, and realised about 30 minutes later that the building was on fire.
## Official response

The chairman of Bokkos Local Government Area confirmed that the council had received reports of the fire. He said the circumstances and the identity of those responsible had not yet been established, and that the damage to the school building was the authorities' immediate concern.
Security agencies had not commented at the time of the reports, and no casualties were mentioned.
## Background
Bokkos and other parts of Plateau State have suffered repeated attacks on rural communities in recent years.
more: The fire started at about 1pm on Sunday.
The attackers have not been identified.
No casualties were reported.

stories.h: Firefighters rescue 70-year-old woman from 60-foot well in Lagos
stories.p: A 70-year-old woman was reportedly rescued alive after falling into a 60-foot well at Oworonshoki, Lagos, early on Sunday. She was stabilised and handed over to her family.
body: A 70-year-old woman has reportedly been rescued alive after falling into a 60-foot-deep well at Oworonshoki, in the Kosofe Local Government Area of Lagos State.
## The rescue
Firefighters from the Oworonshoki Fire Station responded to a distress call in the early hours of Sunday, 22 November 2026, and brought the woman out of the well alive.
## What officials said

The Controller-General of the Lagos State Fire and Rescue Service, Margaret Adeseye, confirmed the incident. She said the woman was stabilised after the rescue and handed over to her family, and praised the firefighters for responding quickly.
## Unanswered questions
How the woman came to fall into the well was not disclosed.
more: The rescue happened early on Sunday.
She was stabilised and handed to her family.
How she fell has not been disclosed.

stories.h: Atiku denies quitting 2027 race, says those spreading the claim are working for Tinubu
stories.p: ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar has reportedly dismissed claims that he has withdrawn from the 2027 election. His campaign said no group calling itself his supporters can speak for him, and accused rivals of tactics that help the ruling party.
body: Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar has reportedly rejected claims that he has pulled out of the 2027 presidential race, describing them as a deliberate falsehood.
## What his campaign said

In a statement issued on Sunday, 22 November 2026, by the director of strategic communication for the ADC Presidential Campaign Council, the campaign is said to have stressed that no group presenting itself as Atiku's supporters had the authority to announce a withdrawal on his behalf.

The statement reportedly accused those behind the claim of borrowing tactics it associated with the ruling APC, such as presenting so-called supporters from a rival camp. It said any opposition party spreading such stories was effectively helping President Bola Tinubu, and urged parties that want to defeat the APC to make their case directly to voters.
## Still campaigning
Atiku's campaign said his Affordable Life campaign was still active and focused on the election.
## Background

The denial comes as campaigns for the January 2027 presidential election gather pace, with Tinubu of the APC, Atiku of the ADC and Peter Obi of the NDC among the leading candidates. Speculation about possible withdrawals and alliances has been circulating online in recent days.
more: Atiku's campaign calls the withdrawal claim false.
It says no group can speak for him.
His Affordable Life campaign continues.

stories.h: Wike says rejecting Tinubu in 2027 would leave reforms unfinished
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly said voting President Tinubu out in 2027 would leave his economic reforms incomplete. He spoke at a church service in Rivers State that dedicated his Rainbow Coalition campaign council.
body: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly warned that rejecting President Bola Tinubu's re-election bid in 2027 would leave the government's economic reforms unfinished and could undo gains already made.
## Where he spoke

Wike made the remarks on Sunday, 22 November 2026, at a thanksgiving and dedication service at St Peter's Anglican Church in Rumueprikom, his hometown in Obio/Akpor Local Government Area of Rivers State. The service formally dedicated the Rainbow Coalition Campaign Council ahead of the elections, and Wike said campaigning would begin on 23 November.
## His argument

He reportedly described Tinubu as a leader who took unpopular but necessary decisions to stop the country from sliding into crisis. As an example, he pointed to the university system, saying the repeated cycle of lecturers' strikes over unpaid entitlements had largely been broken.
## Background

Wike, a former PDP governor of Rivers State, is one of Tinubu's most vocal backers and leads a coalition of PDP members supporting the president. Earlier this month, he told his FCT campaign team not to let opposition parties reach 25 per cent of the vote in Abuja.
more: Wike spoke at a church service in his Rivers hometown.
He says campaigning starts on 23 November.
He pointed to fewer university strikes as a gain.

stories.h: Miley Cyrus marries drummer Maxx Morando in Palm Springs
stories.p: Singer Miley Cyrus has married musician Maxx Morando in a poolside ceremony in Palm Springs, California. The wedding came about a year after the couple got engaged.
body: American singer Miley Cyrus has married drummer Maxx Morando, according to reports.
## The wedding

The 33-year-old pop star and Morando, 28, who plays drums for the band Liily, wed on Saturday, 21 November 2026, in Palm Springs, California. Photos released after the event reportedly showed the couple standing by a swimming pool under an arch decorated with white flowers.
## The guests
Miley's mother, Tish Cyrus, her father, Billy Ray Cyrus, and her sister Noah Cyrus were among the guests. Billy Ray's partner, actress Elizabeth Hurley, and her son Damian also attended.
The couple hosted a rehearsal dinner with loved ones the evening before, with the menu reportedly printed with the couple's initials.
## Background
Miley and Morando got engaged about a year ago. The singer was previously married to Australian actor Liam Hemsworth.

stories.h: Olamide honoured with 'Amuludun' title by Nike Davies-Okundaye
stories.p: Rapper Olamide has reportedly been given the Yoruba title Amuludun by artist Nike Davies-Okundaye during a visit to her Lagos gallery. The honour came days after he released his album Time and Space.
body: Rapper and YBNL boss Olamide has reportedly received a traditional Yoruba honour from the celebrated artist Chief Nike Davies-Okundaye.
## The honour

During a visit to the Nike Art Gallery in Lekki, Lagos, Olamide was given the title Amuludun, which roughly means the one who brings joy to the town. The veteran artist is also said to have presented him with a custom-made beaded portrait.
## A show of respect

A video of the visit shared online showed the rapper chatting warmly with her, and at one point prostrating before her in the traditional Yoruba gesture of respect, a moment that drew attention from fans.
## Background

The visit came just days after Olamide released his latest album, Time and Space, on 16 November 2026. He remains one of the most influential figures in Nigerian hip-hop and Afrobeats, and his YBNL label is home to artists including Fireboy DML and Asake.
## Surprise guest

At a private listening party for Time and Space, Olamide was seen warmly welcoming Seyi Tinubu, son of President Bola Tinubu, who made a surprise appearance. Videos of the two hugging and laughing spread widely online.
more: Olamide visited the Nike Art Gallery in Lekki.
He was also given a beaded portrait.
His album Time and Space came out on 16 November.

stories.h: Regulator says cooking gas prices will fall further as supply rises
stories.p: The petroleum regulator NMDPRA has reportedly said higher local production and better distribution will bring down cooking gas prices. It says prices have already dropped by ₦300–₦400 per kilogram.
body: The federal government has reportedly outlined fresh steps to bring down the price of cooking gas, as many households struggle with high energy costs.
## What the regulator said

The chief executive of the Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority (NMDPRA), Rabiu Umar, said increased domestic production, better distribution and the removal of logistics bottlenecks would help moderate the price of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG). He spoke during a visit to the Nigeria LNG plant and its Train 7 project site in Bonny on Saturday.
Umar is said to have explained that the government is prioritising gas availability and energy security, in line with plans to increase the use of gas within the country.
## Prices already falling

According to the regulator, cooking gas prices have already fallen by between ₦300 and ₦400 per kilogram thanks to improved supply and regulatory action. He blamed earlier price increases on supply problems.
more: Prices have reportedly fallen by ₦300–₦400 per kg.
The regulator visited the NLNG plant in Bonny.
More local supply is expected to push prices down.

stories.h: Aisha Lawal opens up on building collapse that wiped out her savings
stories.p: Actress Aisha Lawal has reportedly spoken about how a building she put her life savings and loans into collapsed in Maryland, Lagos. She shared the story in an interview with Chude Jideonwo.
body: Nollywood actress Aisha Lawal has reportedly opened up about one of the hardest periods of her life, when a building she invested in collapsed.
## What she said

Speaking on the interview series WithChude, hosted by Chude Jideonwo, Lawal said she put her savings, investments and borrowed money into a property project in the Maryland area of Lagos, made up of four flats and a duplex. She said the building was finished down to the tiles and ceiling work.
## The day it fell

She recalled returning from a stage rehearsal when she had a sudden thought to sell the property rather than move in. When she reached the estate, she reportedly found emergency agency vehicles and heavy machinery on the ground, and her phone was flooded with messages about the collapse.
## Background
Lawal is a well-known actress and stage performer. She has recently spoken publicly about other personal matters, including the end of her marriage.

The building had four flats and a duplex.
She told the story on WithChude.

stories.h: Kano Governor Abba Yusuf says his wife was taken from his home before she went to court
stories.p: Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has reportedly given more details about the breakdown of his marriage to Zainab Kwankwaso. In a radio interview he said her belongings were moved out of his house without his knowledge, and that he was shocked when she filed for divorce in Abuja.
body: Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has reportedly opened up further about the collapse of his marriage to Zainab Musa Kwankwaso, a relative of NDC vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso.
## What the governor said

Speaking in a Hausa-language interview on Sunday, 22 November 2026, Yusuf is said to have described family matters as extremely difficult. He reportedly said he and Zainab married about 20 years ago and have children together.

According to the reports, the governor said her belongings were moved out of his house and she was taken away from his home without his knowledge, but that he stayed patient and said nothing in public. He said he had even assured their children that their mother would come back, and was shocked to learn that she had gone to court, in Abuja rather than in Kano.
Yusuf reportedly declined to give details of how she left, but said he had witnesses. Asked why he was speaking publicly, he said he was not the one who had made the matter political.
## Background

Earlier this week, Zainab Kwankwaso reportedly filed for divorce at an Upper Area Court in Abuja. The governor later told pensioners at Government House in Kano that he had accepted the dissolution of the marriage and still planned to marry again.
The split has drawn wide attention because Kwankwaso was long the governor's political mentor before the two fell out.
## The other side
No response from Zainab Kwankwaso or Rabiu Kwankwaso was included in the reports.
## Who Zainab is

Zainab is the daughter of Kwankwaso's late elder brother and grew up in Kwankwaso's household. She married Yusuf in 2006, and the couple have six children. The governor reportedly suggested that Kwankwaso was behind the events that led to her leaving.
more: Yusuf says he was shocked she went to court in Abuja.
